scope: Product work independent of deferred public hosting
changes: Password change in account settings requires the current password and revokes other sessions through Better Auth; password fields stay in component memory.
Custom mismatch and incorrect-password feedback; shared action lock; unsaved profile and password drafts participate in navigation protection.
Lite generation is disabled after local curriculum edits until the plan is saved and confirmed again.

verification.chromium: 9 of 10 initial product checks passed; remaining API case initially encountered the active rate limiter. A bounded retry was added without weakening validation assertions; both account cases then passed.
verification.webkit: 2 critical scenarios passed: password/session/profile preservation and canonical confirmed curriculum generation
verification.accessibility: Account security scope passed axe and horizontal overflow checks at 360px; mobile screenshot visually inspected.
verification.api: Anonymous 401, cross-origin 403, incomplete and short-password 400; current session remains usable, old credentials rejected and other session revoked after change.
verification.providerCalls: No paid AI calls made for these checks.

limitations: Forgotten-password recovery still requires configured mail delivery.
Public Netlify/Railway deployment remains deferred by the owner; local verification does not prove future cloud operation.
Cross-tab conflicts, ambiguous save recovery and broader product audit remain open.
